sourceDescription: NMC letter D-11011/500/2024-AcademicCell dated 12-09-2024 with CBME Curriculum 2024 and competency volumes; Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (CODE: FM) table read at text offsets 320000-450000 of 801400.
verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that quotes short rows and restates long rows. PDF bytes, the pinned SHA-256, sourceBodySha256 values, rendered pages and table-cell alignment were not independently verified. Identity of this file with the pinned source PDF is assumed from title and date, not proven. No source prose stored.
scope: All 156 Forensic Medicine references that lacked selected review evidence at the checked head (FM1.1-FM14.20; FM10.19 already reviewed; FM2.12 not in the pending set).
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, legal, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
Statute names and section numbers in the official rows were not checked against current law.
New holds are recorded here only; the 154-reference original hold inventory is unchanged.
certificationCountReported values are reader-reported and need a rendered-page check before use.

rows.note: The official row also names conduct money, types of witnesses, court questions and conduct of the doctor in the witness box; the draft role-play covers summons, oath or affirmation and the three stages of examination only.
rows.evidenceToResolve: Add the omitted elements in a versioned task revision, or record which other task carries them.

rows.note: Official row also names molecular death; draft does not.
Official term is suspended animation; draft uses apparent death.
Official row covers custodial deaths and deaths after human-rights violations; draft names custodial death only.
Draft reframes race, religion and complexion as social descriptors needing independent documentation; scope retained, framing added.
Official row uses historical terms (impotence, frigidity); draft addresses their limitations.
Official row names the Consumer Protection Act 2019; draft says current sources.
Draft adds withholding and withdrawing treatment to euthanasia and DNR; elaboration.
Official row names Res Ipsa Loquitur; draft does not name it.
Official row names the doctor-patient relationship; draft does not.

The official row is the examination of an accused in sexual offence cases, including framing the opinion, preserving and dispatching trace evidence, and discussing objectivity; the draft is a generic authorized examination of an accused person and omits the sexual-offence context and trace evidence.
rows.evidenceToResolve: Revise the task to the sexual-offence accused examination with trace-evidence handling, keeping the objectivity element.

rows.note: Official row names the MoHFW medico-legal care guidelines; draft does not name them.

nextAction: Resolve FM1.5 and FM14.13 against rendered official pages, then continue with Obstetrics and Gynaecology (141 pending references).
